text: Scheidt masked the English before enciphering it. If the mask leaves no forward English, a climb tuned to English may pass the right key by.
Carter's prose reversed, with an X every kth letter, or spread one letter in every nth place, enciphered at F1.1's length 23 and climbed by 0140's frozen search beside six scrambled copies each.

Reversed messages are found by the climb's own score, 7 of 8. An X every kth letter (best 5 of 8) and the message in every nth place (best 3 of 8) are not: F1.1 and F1.2's sampled closes hold for unmasked or reversed English only.
